description.en: Connect GitHub, Linear, Slack, Google Calendar, Gmail or any OpenAPI, GraphQL or MCP API, share connections with your team, fix sign-ins, and choose per tool whether agents may run it, must ask, or never run it.
description.ja: GitHub、Linear、Slack、Google カレンダー、Gmail、または任意の OpenAPI・GraphQL・MCP API を接続し、チームと共有し、サインインを修復し、ツールごとにエージェントが実行できるか、確認が必要か、実行しないかを選べます。

scopes.integration:read: List your team's connections, their health and the team's integration policy.

optionalScopes.integration:write: Start a connection, sign in again, share it with your team, disconnect it (cmux confirms first), turn its MCP exposure on or off, or change a tool's policy when you click those buttons.
optionalScopes.workspace:write: Open the Integrations pane from the palette or the sidebar.
